title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Courtesy Decision Table: Open Dispute Allowance
content:
**Rule.** On a courtesy credit for a late fee on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the dispute allowance is added to the courtesy share, the share of the late fee being reversed that the courtesy credit returns. The dispute allowance is 0.3 when the amount under open billing dispute on the account (the disputed amounts of its dispute filings less those of its resolutions and withdrawals) is at least the missed minimum, 0.15 when it is above zero but less than the missed minimum, and zero when nothing is under open billing dispute. The missed minimum is the minimum payment due of the statement of the billing period that the most recent late fee on the account belongs to. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

## Decision table

| Amount under open billing dispute | Dispute allowance |
|---|---|
| at least the missed minimum | 0.3 |
| above zero, below the missed minimum | 0.15 |
| zero | zero |

## Cases (hypothetical; missed minimum USD 55.00)

| Dispute filings | Resolutions and withdrawals | Under open dispute | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 206.00 | none | USD 206.00 | 0.3 |
| USD 55.00 | none | USD 55.00 | 0.3 |
| USD 120.00 | USD 80.00 | USD 40.00 | 0.15 |
| USD 120.00 | USD 120.00 | zero | zero |
